bio.text: Matt Haney, a Democrat, represents the 17th Assembly District, which covers San Francisco, in the California State Assembly.

According to a press release on his official website, he was sworn in on May 3, 2022, after a special election, and previously represented District 6 on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors and served on the San Francisco Board of Education from 2013 to 2019.

The same release says he holds a BA from UC Berkeley, an MA from Stanford University School of Education, a JD from Stanford Law School and an LLM in human rights from National University of Ireland, and lives in San Francisco.
